source.checkpoint: same source97 seed1 weights used by SW0143-T
source.graph_operator: frozen SW0143-T native32 geodesic graph operator
source.encoder: frozen source97 seed1 RGB encoder and native32 patcher
source.ids: same ordered first 2048 source TRAIN IDs as SW0155; TRAIN masks only
source.scale_rule: Per component, sqrt(mean of squared source97_T margin RMS from equal-size registered SW0157 batches at source positions 0-3 and 2048-2051); fixed before training, no refit.

emitter.native_gate: g from the existing sinusoidal gate; unchanged
emitter.detached_control: Same forward expression and same recurrent emitted spike, but detach M only inside the additional amplitude factor; native event surrogate gradients remain intact.
emitter.recurrence: Assign S' to the native membrane spike state before the next step; that same S' feeds the following dendrite and native membrane reset. Native reset formula/coefficient are unchanged.

training.objective: Unchanged SW0155 supervised_relation_loss on actual amplitude-modulated emitted spikes and canonical TRAIN modal32 masks.
training.trainable: Native core excluding frozen graph weights, 12 existing phase-integration scalars, and eta[4].
training.frozen: Source RGB encoder, native32 patcher, and installed SW0143-T graph weights/operator.

preflight.training_images: first four IDs of the registered ordered source TRAIN prefix; masks are used only through the unchanged SW0155 modal32 supervised-relation objective
requirements: eta-zero exact six-trace, production actual-spike Q, and production QCC parity with frozen source97-T
two disposable updates with registered optimizer families
finite actual emitted/reset traces and exact recurrence/reset input checks
eta gradient and parameter change on both updates
same-state/same-RNG live-vs-detached six-trace/Q/loss equality after update 1 and before update 2
finite nonzero live amplitude-path membrane credit exceeding repeated-live gradient residual
descriptive_outputs: post-update-1 actual-spike Q change versus eta zero at identical core state
settled per-node temporal variance of the amplitude factor on nonzero native event-gate support
aggregate amplitude-factor statistics, explicitly not a substitute for temporal variance
preflight.training_admission: No full training unless all preflight checks pass.

evaluation.ground_truth: Open target masks only after source, live, and detached predictions are all frozen and validated.
evaluation.promotion: The live arm must exceed both frozen source-T and detached-control foreground ARI by at least 0.01 with positive paired 95% bootstrap lower bounds; otherwise close this recipe without sweeps or seed expansion.
evaluation.limitations: This intervention modulates event amplitude, not binary event occupancy. It does not claim to desaturate E, establish gate necessity, or guarantee performance improvement.
